info.name: major-project-be
info.description:
Complete API test collection for the AI-Augmented Project & Requirements Management System.

Rewritten (session 2) to match the actual implemented API — the previous version of this file predated most of the real design (it used a nonexistent "developer" role instead of client/pm/member, called a backend /api/auth/login endpoint that was never implemented since login is Supabase-direct, used Title-Case statuses instead of the real UPPER_SNAKE_CASE enums, omitted the required client_id on project creation, and called the AI WBS endpoints at the wrong path). Every request below was verified against a live run of major-project-be.

Before running: set the `supabaseUrl` and `supabaseAnonKey` collection variables from major-project-fe/.env (VITE_SUPABASE_URL / VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) if they aren't already filled in, and set `baseUrl` to your running backend (default http://localhost:4000).

Test accounts are generated fresh on every run (emails include a random suffix via a collection-level pre-request script), so this collection is safe to re-run repeatedly without 409 email collisions — note this does mean each run leaves a few new throwaway accounts/projects in your Supabase project; periodically clean these up from the dashboard.

Testing order:
1. Auth & Setup (register + Supabase-direct login for pm/client/member)
2. Projects & Access Control (CRUD + multi-tenant isolation)
3. Requirements (FSM + versioning + impact analysis)
4. Specifications (create/finalize + status-gate)
5. Tasks (CRUD + DFS + BFS + ownership)
6. Algorithms (CPM + Traceability)
7. AI WBS Generation (HITL) — calls the real Groq API, requires GROQ_API_KEY configured
8. RBAC & Security Edge Cases
